extension.name: SMS Chat
extension.description: Real-time SMS conversation view on the contact record: a Google Messages-style chat tab over CiviCRM's native SMS activities (Inbound SMS / SMS delivery), with per-line attribution, sending, and polling updates. Provider-agnostic with Twilio support included.

compatibility.comments: Semantic versioning. For example, compatibility with "6.1" implies compatibility with "6.2".

php_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "8.1" and "8.2".

smarty_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "4" and "5".

extension.comments: Chat-style SMS UI over native SMS activities. Env-driven configuration via CIVICRM_SMS_CHAT_* variables; subscriber-pattern hooks under BlackBrickSoftware\CiviCRMSmsChat\Subscriber\. See DESIGN.md.
